expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc before '0.8.4' does not perform bytecode-cycle reachability analysis, so it only emits an unused-parameter warning and succeeds. Slang implements the '0.8.4' cycle-detection semantics for every version, so it reports the circular `new` dependency and fails on '0.8.0' to '0.8.3', where solc does not. From '0.8.4' solc reports the same `TypeError 7813`, so both fail and agree.
